@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@

 ```
 
-`request` takes no further argument; any other argument is the usage refusal of the `search` and `read` commands. The command reads standard input to its end.
+`request` takes no further argument; any other argument is the usage refusal of the `search` and `read` commands. The command accepts at most 1 MiB (1048576 bytes) on standard input, counting all bytes including whitespace. At or below the limit, it uses the complete input and applies the normal JSON, version and schema checks. Larger input is refused before JSON parsing with `invalid_request` and exit status 2, without echoing any request data. This limit does not apply to packet output.
 
 Every outcome, success or refusal, is exactly one compact JSON packet on stdout followed by `\n`; stderr stays empty.
